GB-OSTN15-OSGM15-fwd.title: ETRS89 -> OSGB36 National Grid + ODN/local datum (OSTN15/OSGM15)
tools: Ordnance Survey OSTN15/OSGM15 developer pack test files
GB-OSTN15-OSGM15-fwd.diagnosis: PROJ uses the OSTN15 NTv2 lat/long grid and a lat/long GeoTIFF of OSGM15; OS test outputs come from the definitive 1-km E/N grids. Differences up to 7.4 mm horizontal / 2.0 mm vertical. Use the definitive OSTN15 algorithm if sub-cm agreement with OS is required.

GB-OSGM15-Belfast.diagnosis: OSGM15 Belfast as GeoTIFF vs OS native grid interpolation: 1.0-1.6 mm at 3 of 100 points.

FR-L93.title: RGF93 v2b geographic -> Lambert-93
FR-L93.diagnosis: IGN fiche geographic and Lambert-93 values are mutually inconsistent by up to 1.7 mm (published on different dates); PROJ and an independent LCC implementation agree to <0.01 mm.

FR-RAF20.title: RGF93 v2b h -> NGF-IGN69 altitude (RAF20) vs published levelled altitude
FR-RAF20.diagnosis: RAF20 model residual vs published levelled NGF-IGN69 altitude: 3.3-12 cm at 4 of 30 marks (Rhone valley / Alps, re-observed 2024). Model accuracy, not engine.

CH-LV95LN02-to-ETRS89.title: LV95 E/N + LN02 H -> ETRS89 lat/lon/h
CH-LV95LN02-to-ETRS89.diagnosis: PROJ uses the single swisstopo grid chgeo2004_htrans_ETRS (LN02<->ETRS89); REFRAME chains HTRANS (LN02->LHN95) + CHGeo2004 + Bessel shift. 7-12 mm at high-altitude marks (Calanda 2805 m, Zermatt).

CH-ETRS89-to-LHN95.title: ETRS89 h -> LHN95 orthometric height (CHGeo2004)
tools: swisstopo REFRAME REST ln02tolhn95 (+lv95towgs84 for h)

WGS84-EGM2008.title: WGS 84 / ITRF h -> EGM2008 height (2.5-arcmin grid) vs NRCan GPS·H EGM08
tools: NRCan GPS·H web service, model EGM08, frame=ITRF2014
WGS84-EGM2008.diagnosis: GPS·H EGM08 vs PROJ 2.5-arcmin EGM2008 grid: up to 10.8 mm. PROJ-data has no 1-arcmin EGM2008 grid (us_nga_egm08_1.tif 404); GPS·H resolution/method undocumented (suspected 1-arcmin grid or harmonic synthesis). EPSG states 0.113 m for the 2.5-arcmin op.

WGS84-EGM96.title: WGS 84 h -> EGM96 height (15-arcmin grid)
tools: NGA EGM96 interpolation package (INTPT.F test output OUTINTPT.DAT)
WGS84-EGM96.diagnosis: NGA reference output uses a 4x4 spline (INTPT.F IWINDO=4); PROJ is bilinear. PROJ equals bilinear interpolation of NGA WW15MGH.GRD to <=0.3 mm (expected_alt).

CD-CHS-BM-vs-NRCan.title: CHS benchmark height above CD + CHS station offset vs NRCan levelled height of the same mark
tools: NRCan station report (Vertical Data table, levelling)
CD-CHS-BM-vs-NRCan.diagnosis: CHS-derived (benchmark CD elevation + station offset) minus NRCan levelled height on the same marks: CGVD2013 mean -4.0 cm (systematic, n=20), CGVD28 mean -2.3 cm, IGLD85 -0.2 cm. Beyond 5 cm: Sept-Iles (7.5-14 cm), North Sydney CGVD28 (9 cm), Lauzon 74L9000 (6-10 cm, wharf-wall mark likely moved), Vieux-Quebec 19L760B CGVD2013 (5.6 cm). The CGVD2013 bias suggests CHS CGVD2013 offsets were not derived from NRCan CGVD2013 levelling; cause not confirmed - ask CHS.

CD-CHS-NAD83-vs-CGVD28+HT2_2010v70.title: CHS CD ellipsoidal (NAD83_CSRS) vs CHS CD_in_CGVD28 + HT2_2010v70
CD-CHS-NAD83-vs-CGVD28+HT2_2010v70.diagnosis: HTv2.0 vs CHS CGVD28 offsets: 6-22 cm at Newfoundland, Labrador and Bay of Fundy stations (CGVD28 poorly realised there; HTv2.0 stated 5 cm). Use CGVD2013+CGG2013a for CD conversions.

CD-FR-RAM-vs-BathyElli.title: France: RAM zh_elli (port) vs BathyElli v2.1 ZH surface (IDW of 6 nearest nodes)
